reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi R05 reserve re-verify (yzusd-yuzu); Pharos reserve research refresh
reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29: the Accountable dashboard's exposure_split timestamp is 2026-08-28 09:26:05 UTC. It reports named strategy values including Ethena USDe, Sky USDS staking, Aave USDC, Maple syrupUSDT/syrupUSDG/syrupUSDC loops, Agora PT AUSD, Yuzu yzPRIME, Superstate USTB, PayPal PYUSD, Ethena sUSDe, Liquidity_Buffer, Sky PT sUSDS, Fasanara mGLO/mGLOBAL, Aave USDT0/RLUSD/GHO/GHO Savings, and Securitize VBILL. The named positive exposure values total $63,611,871.26, while the nearest contemporaneous reserve timeline total is $63,751,113.85; Accountable's Rest_of_Assets bucket is $83,029.55. The resulting 0.348657% residual is retained as Other reserve assets rather than silently normalizing the split to 100%; the tiny sub-cent Ethena USDe entry is below the positive percentage precision and is omitted. New Sky and PayPal buckets are retained as explicit protocol-position slices, but they have no reviewed tracked-coin link in the current adapter map. No strategy-level allocation beyond these Accountable buckets is inferred.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable exposure_split snapshot dated 2026-08-28 09:26:05 UTC, normalized to the nearest contemporaneous timeline reserve total with an explicit reconciliation residual
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: 0.348657% of the nearest timeline backing total consists of Accountable Rest_of_Assets plus the residual between the named exposure split and that timeline total; the tiny sub-cent Ethena USDe bucket is below stored percentage precision. Custody, leverage, and legal treatment of the disclosed strategy positions remain incompletely documented.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: yzPRIME is Yuzu's own prime fund token, not a tracked third-party stablecoin dependency.
Midas mGLO (Fasanara Global Diversified Alternative Debt strategy) is not a tracked Pharos asset, so no dependency edge can be linked; the sister mGLOBAL token is tracked as mglobal-midas-fasanara.

Accountable Rest_of_Assets plus the residual reconciliation amount is not individually mapped to a named strategy or tracked stablecoin; it remains an unlinked basket with insufficient evidence for a more precise classification.
